questions.question: How much process should this quick PR carry? Both errors are latent: an assistant record with usage but no `id` would make every later id-less call get skipped (undercount), and under `python -OO` `__doc__` is None so argparse setup crashes.

options.label: New BUG item, full protocol (Recommended)
options.description: Mint a BUG-xxx, register it done in BACKLOG-DONE, small trace, regression test seen failing first, then fix. Matches CLAUDE.md's bug-fix protocol; about 20 extra minutes.

options.label: Chore PR, no backlog ID
options.description: Fix plus one regression test, commit without an item ID. Fastest, but departs from the repo's 'every fix has an ID and trace' convention.

options.label: Fold into a later report-token-usage item
options.description: Don't open a PR now; note the two defects for whoever next touches the script (e.g. the chars/4 calibration finding from this analysis).
